day_titles.8: On to Osaka and a walking tour

1: Arrival at Narita or Haneda and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Shinjuku hotel
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the Tokyo Metropolitan Building viewing decks, free of charge
2: Breakfast, then a guided day through the city
Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes
3: Breakfast, then out of the city towards Mount Fuji
The fifth station on the mountain, weather permitting
Lake Ashi and the Hakone viewpoints
A shopping stop at the Gotemba outlets
4: Breakfast and check out, then the train north
Check in at Nozawa Onsen in the mountains
Rest of the day free at the hot spring baths
Optional: a walk through the old village lanes
5: Breakfast, then a full day out with your guide
A tasting at an old sake brewery
6: Breakfast and check out, then the train to Kyoto
Check in at your ryokan in Gion
Futons, tatami and a soak in the shared bath
Optional: an evening walk through Pontocho
7: Breakfast, then a full day out with your guide
Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, on its pond
The deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara
The bamboo grove and Sagano scenic train at Arashiyama
8: Breakfast and check out, then the train to Osaka
A half day walking tour of the city
Dotonbori and the Kuromon market stalls
9: Early breakfast, then across to Universal Studios Japan
Tickets included for the full day
Super Nintendo World and the Harry Potter area
10: Early breakfast, then a full day west
The Peace Memorial Park and the A-Bomb Dome
The floating torii gate before the ride back
11: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Two nights in the Nagano mountains is what lifts this above the usual Tokyo and Kyoto week. Hot spring baths and monkeys.
expert.tip: Nozawa Onsen has free public baths dotted through the village. Take a small towel and work your way round after the monkeys.

summary: Eleven days for two: three nights in Shinjuku with a city day and Mount Fuji, two in the Nagano mountains for the snow monkeys and a sake tasting, two ryokan nights in Gion with Kyoto, Nara and Arashiyama, then three in Osaka with Universal Studios and Hiroshima.
included: Included: 10 nights with breakfast on most mornings, including a mountain hotel at Nozawa Onsen and a Kyoto ryokan; bullet trains throughout; private airport transfers; Tokyo sightseeing tour; Mount Fuji fifth station with Hakone and the Gotemba outlets; snow monkeys, Zenkoji temple and sake day trip; Kyoto and Nara tour with Arashiyama and the Sagano train; Osaka walking tour; Universal Studios Japan tickets; Hiroshima and Miyajima tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
